manualFollowUps: Pages: the empty project schood-company already exists, so the merge deploy ships apps/company, apps/english-hub (recognises the company-seat product) and apps/platform (Account page shows a company seat). After merging, run the 'Configure Schood Company English Domain' workflow to bind company.schood.online. Until the function is deployed, signed-in pages show a connection error; the landing page renders without it.

Trials: straight after the migrations, supabase functions deploy trial-claim --project-ref bbjawctnqrufvnesdsel so it refuses hidden products. Trials are off by default, so the seconds in between expose nothing unless platform trials are switched on.

Database: supabase db push --linked --include-all from an isolated copy of the installed migrations plus only the four company migrations (20261031100000, 20261031120000, 20261031130000, 20261031140000), keeping the 9 pending #220 payment migrations (20261010162000-20261010174000) excluded. Dry run first. Additive: new company_* tables (RLS on, service role only), a hidden product 'English All Skills (company seat)' with no plans, company_* functions, the erasure registry and hook gain the company tables, and two nightly pg_cron jobs if pg_cron is installed (training draft purge, English access reconcile).

English functions, before any seat exists (--project-ref bbjawctnqrufvnesdsel): supabase functions deploy hub; supabase functions deploy admin-english-ops; supabase functions deploy grammar-remediation; supabase functions deploy immersion-missions; supabase functions deploy listening-content; supabase functions deploy reading-articles; supabase functions deploy speaking-studio; supabase functions deploy vocabulary-notebook; supabase functions deploy writing-workbench. They now treat the company-seat product as all skills. They also pick up one additive duel change from Schood AI (english-duel-service.ts), which is unchanged unless a duel brings its own questions.

Secrets (--project-ref bbjawctnqrufvnesdsel): supabase secrets set COMPANY_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://company.schood.online; supabase secrets set COMPANY_SELF_SERVE=true; supabase secrets set COMPANY_APP_URL=https://company.schood.online. Optional, with defaults: COMPANY_PILOT_TESTS (10), COMPANY_AI_DAILY_LIMIT (300 AI calls per workspace per day). ENGLISH_APP_URL is an existing optional hub setting with a default and needs no change; to override it: supabase secrets set ENGLISH_APP_URL=https://english.schood.online.

Edge: supabase functions deploy company --project-ref bbjawctnqrufvnesdsel (verify_jwt=false in config.toml; the function checks sessions itself). AI goes through the existing English gateway, so calls are logged in english_ai_calls and each company-* feature can be switched off in the English control centre.

Commercial: pilots are self-serve (10 tests, no seats, no lessons or AI practice). Seats, test limits and contract dates are set by Schood staff at /staff. A seat is a separate hidden entitlement row with source 'company' and never touches a learner's purchase.
verification: supabase migration list --linked shows the four 20261031 company migrations applied and the 9 #220 payment migrations still pending.
Anon REST select on company_orgs and company_members is refused (no anon or authenticated grants); public plans list has no plan for product c0a1e5d2-7b3f-4a86-9c14-5e2f8d6b1a07.
POST /functions/v1/trial-claim?product_id=c0a1e5d2-7b3f-4a86-9c14-5e2f8d6b1a07 with a session never creates an entitlement.

GET /functions/v1/company/me without a session returns 401; GET /functions/v1/company/public/v/UNKNOWN returns 404; POST /functions/v1/company/public/leads with an empty body returns 400; a browser preflight from https://company.schood.online is allowed and one from another origin is not.
GET /functions/v1/hub/today without a session still returns 401, and english.schood.online loads.
https://company.schood.online renders the landing page in en, ru and uz; /t/unknowntoken shows the link-not-active message; a deep link reloads without a 404.

Owner, signed in with a real account: create a pilot at /start, make a hiring test, take it from a private window, see the graded result; /staff lists the workspace for a Schood admin; give a seat to a test employee and confirm Schood English unlocks, then remove it and confirm it locks.

rollback.pages: Cloudflare Pages rollback of schood-company, schood-english and schood-platform to the previous deployment, or remove the company.schood.online custom domain.
rollback.migration: Leave the additive tables in place. To stop access: set every company_orgs.status to 'suspended' and run select public.company_sync_org_access(id) from public.company_orgs, which switches off every seat row and touches no purchase.
rollback.edge: supabase functions delete company, or redeploy the previous main commit of the English functions and trial-claim (a696a9fb); no other function depends on company.
